title: CRTF.PROG.------VT.SCI.
description: Second diagram on page 118 (ALT(FT)II-12), paired with C-ACT x INDIV-TD above. The crossing diagrams how cross-transfer-progressionalism structurally meets vibrational-science at the transformational-creative-musician scale the prose names: CRTF-PROG (cross-transfer progressionalism) crossed with VT-SCI (vibrational science). CRTF-PROG sits at upper-right with the subject-arrow; VT-SCI at lower-center as partner-axis. AF-POST (affinity postulation) center-left and PRI-INFO (principle information) center. APP-DT (application dictates) right of crtf-prog. RE-CONT (recontinuance) at left and FUND-DY (fundamental dynamics) below PRI-INFO as the subject's leftward chain. REL-TECH (relevant technology) center-right with SPT-AW (spiritual awareness) and C-INFO (composite information) anchoring the right margin. EXPN-DT (expansion dictates) at bottom. Structural argument: when cross-transfer-progressionalism is crossed with vibrational-science, the leftward chain runs from the main line to AF-POST, then RE-CONT branches from the AF-POST line, PRI-INFO from the RE-CONT line and FUND-DY from the PRI-INFO line. On the right, APP-DT branches from the main line with REL-TECH hanging from it; a vertical drops from the main line to EXPN-DT, with C-INFO branching from it and SPT-AW from the C-INFO line.
